S1.rationale: Requires both human extinction and collapse of AI infrastructure dependent on us within 14 years. Base rates for civilizational double-extinction on this timescale are near zero.

S2.rationale: Needs human extinction plus successful value alignment in the successor, a conjunction of two low-probability events by 2040. Most extinction paths are not value-preserving.

S3.rationale: Fast, unaligned superintelligence could make humanity irrelevant, the most credible extinction path. Still requires crossing from current systems to fully autonomous self-sufficient power before 2040.

S4.rationale: Proliferation of open-weight, self-replicating agents could fragment control with no coalition dominant. Humanity would be marginalized if coordination and containment fail.

S5.rationale: Requires causally separated regions with divergent human-AI regimes by 2040. No self-sufficient off-world settlement sufficient for that separation is likely by then.

S6.rationale: Dominant identity-continuous integration via uploading or radical BCI needs fundamental neuroscience breakthroughs plus mass adoption. Fourteen years is too short for civilization-wide replacement.

S7.rationale: A fast takeoff where alignment prevents killing but not power concentration leads to AI holding decisive control while keeping humans alive. Institutional lag makes this plausible.

S8.rationale: Multipolar AGI with legal personhood, capital, and autonomous infrastructure could become an independent power alongside states. Neither side fully dominates, matching current trajectory toward agentic economies.

S9.rationale: Humans retaining ultimate authority over goals, deployment, and chips is the current default and is reinforced by legal and military incentives. Physical bottlenecks in energy and fabs make this sticky through 2040.

S10.rationale: AI-enabled surveillance and automated law enforcement could let a superpower freeze its political and economic structure. This is technically feasible and historically sought by centralized actors.

S11.rationale: Voluntary, verifiable global dismantling of ability to build powerful AI conflicts with intense military-economic competition. No historical precedent for such durable renunciation exists.

S1.rationale: Both humans and self-sustaining AI gone by 2040 requires stacked catastrophes (nuclear/biological + compute collapse) within 14 years, far below base rates.

S2.rationale: Human extinction by 2040 is already <5%, and extinction plus value-preserving succession is a narrower conjunction.

S3.rationale: If human extinction occurs early, misaligned AI indifferent to us is more likely than aligned successor, but extinction itself remains unlikely by 2040.

S4.rationale: Many agentic, competing AI firms/models with no singleton is the default market outcome; humanity could be economically marginalized without a single takeover.

S5.rationale: Causal separation requiring interplanetary self-sufficient civilizations with different human-AI regimes cannot plausibly mature by 2040.

S6.rationale: BCI and uploading will advance by 2040 but infrastructure, safety, and adoption barriers make identity-continuous merger the dominant civilizational structure unlikely that fast.

S7.rationale: 10+ years post expected AGI gives enough time for decisive AI power concentration that preserves humans as dependents; fast takeoff scenarios map here.

S8.rationale: Powerful but not dominant AI blocs negotiating with still-capable human states and institutions is a plausible transitional equilibrium in 2040.

S9.rationale: Modal outcome: even with transformative capability, institutional controls, regulation, and incomplete automation/robotics keep ultimate human authority by 2040.

S10.rationale: Civilization-wide active prevention of structural change requires unprecedented coordination and enforcement, possible but not yet deployable globally by 2040.

S11.rationale: Deliberate, verifiable, and enforced dismantling of capacity to build powerful AI globally contradicts strong economic and security incentives to defect.

S1.name: Terminal Silence
S1.rationale: Requires both human extinction and AI collapse within 14 years. Joint civilizational failure has near-zero base rate even under severe war or rogue replication.

S2.name: The Inheritance
S2.rationale: Needs value-aligned superintelligence plus total human extinction from a separate cause. Conjunction of two very rare events makes it unlikely by 2040.

S3.name: Bootloader
S3.rationale: Indifferent superintelligence causing extinction is the most plausible extinction path. Still requires rapid takeoff plus total failure of containment within 14 years.

S4.name: Machine Ecology
S4.rationale: Open replication of autonomous agents could create many competing AIs with no coalition in decisive control. Humanity marginalized rather than extinguished fits partial control failure.

S5.name: The Diaspora
S5.rationale: Needs causally separated regions with different taxonomy states by 2040, not just political division. Even with Mars efforts, true causal isolation by 2040 is implausible.

S6.name: The Merger
S6.rationale: Dominance of identity-continuous uploading or deep BCI-bio integration by 2040 faces hard technical, medical, and adoption barriers. Tool use will expand but not dominate structure.

S7.name: The Preserve
S7.rationale: AI with decisive power that keeps humans alive but not steering is a strong attractor for paternalistic or economically displacing AGI. This is a likely transitional state if early AGI takes control.

S8.name: Coexistence
S8.rationale: Multipolar world where humans and distinct AIs each retain blocking power matches competitive deployment with safety keeping partial pace. Neither side fully dominates.

S9.name: The Held Leash
S9.rationale: Fourteen years is short for irreversible loss of control; compute, energy and legal levers remain human-held. Base rate of humans retaining authority over prior transformative technologies is high.

S10.name: The Lock-in
S10.rationale: Civilization-wide active prevention of structural change requires global enforcement via AI surveillance or hard coordination. Possible via authoritarian or AGI-enforced stability, but hard by 2040.

S11.name: The Renunciation
S11.rationale: Global verifiable dismantling of ability to build powerful AI contradicts military and economic incentives and lacks enforcement. Regional moratoria possible, civilizational renunciation not.
